# Puragain Water — California Water Filtration Systems

> Puragain Water installs home water filtration systems that remove 99% of contaminants from your tap water. Family-owned with over 30 years in the water industry, serving homeowners across Southern California.

## Service Area
Southern California — including San Diego County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and San Bernardino County. Cities served include San Diego, Los Angeles, Escondido, Oceanside, Carlsbad, Riverside, Moreno Valley, Corona, Fontana, Temecula, Palmdale, Lancaster, and Santa Clarita. Free in-home water testing throughout the region.

## Products
- 5-Stage Reverse Osmosis System ($26/month) — removes lead, PFAS, chlorine, bacteria, and 99% of contaminants from your kitchen tap
- 6-Stage Alkaline System ($42/month) — all RO benefits plus alkaline mineral restoration, raises pH to 9.5
- Whole House Filtersorb System ($74/month) — clean water from every tap, shower, and appliance, salt-free conditioning

## What's Included
- Zero money down on all systems
- Free professional installation
- 7-year warranty
- Lifetime servicing plan (annual water testing, annual maintenance, unlimited service calls)
- 24/7 live support
